Change all the copy to add instead of fluorescent orange there use a different fluorescent color. You can pick make it purple gradient to blue gradient.   # 10 Reasons People Switch to OneHub

### 1. One Workspace

Stop jumping between dozens of apps.

### 2. One Memory

Your AI remembers your projects, brand, and previous work.

### 3. One Command

Describe the outcome—not every step.

### 4. One Team of AI

Use specialized AI agents for writing, coding, design, research, marketing, and automation.

### 5. One Content Engine

Create videos, images, websites, social posts, presentations, emails, and documents from the same project.

### 6. One Automation Hub

Connect your tools and let OneHub handle repetitive tasks automatically.

### 7. One Research Assistant

Analyze competitors, trends, products, customers, and markets in minutes.

### 8. One Creative Studio

Generate graphics, thumbnails, mockups, logos, videos, and marketing assets without switching software.

### 9. One Place to Build

From a simple idea to a finished business, everything stays in the same workspace.

### 10. One Platform That Grows With You

Whether you're a creator, entrepreneur, freelancer, agency, or business owner, OneHub adapts to how you work—not the other way around.
